sections.title: The problem
sections.html:
The problem

What it is there to fix.

Repeat offenders slip through

A person arrested in one district and released in another leaves no connected trail, so the pattern never surfaces.

Seizures sit in separate files

Substance, quantity and place are recorded case by case, with nothing linking a supplier to the peddlers working for them.

Releases go unnoticed

An offender returns to a jurisdiction where no officer was told, and preventive action happens too late or not at all.
